commit.subject: LU-16518 lov: remove unused lsm inline helpers
commit.message:
LU-16518 lov: remove unused lsm inline helpers

... since they are no longer used. copy_lsm_entry() has been
unused ever since it was first introduced. lsm_has_objects()
lost its last caller a long time ago.

Fixes: 7107e54983b0 ("LU-9008 pfl: dynamic layout modification with write/truncate")
Fixes: fcd45488711a ("LU-5683 clio: add CIT_DATA_VERSION")
Test-Parameters: trivial
Signed-off-by: Timothy Day <timday@thelustrecollective.com>
Change-Id: Id77dc420757b9196968e7549ff32713ec0c7df0b
